facts.assessment_goals: Screen CS aptitude for high-volume inbound hires
facts.context_summary: UK entry-level contact centre inbound English remote max 45 min screening

conversation.content: We are hiring fifty entry-level contact centre agents in the UK handling inbound calls—English only. We need screening under forty-five minutes total per candidate where possible and remote delivery. We especially want simulations or realistic phone-style assessments plus customer-service orientation and aptitude for multitasking. What SHL assessments should we use?
